title: Last-minute travel & expense ops cheatlog
content:
Quick scratchpad for last-minute travel admin: receipts, visa notes, vendor handoffs, and packing/kit ops. Mostly a brain dump + TODOs.

PURPOSE
- Keep receipts sane when on the road; avoid 2-week backlog.
- Make cross-border vendor/shipping smoother (customs docs, contact points).
- Visa reminder checklist for short notice travel.

TODOS (top priority)
- Confirm courier pickup window for booth crate: ask Samir for ETA window and upload airway bill to Drive.
- Quick SIM (local) for on-site team: buy for on-call + backup hotspot.
- Confirm corporate card limit with finance for per-diem cash advance.
- Upload scanned invoices (VAT) to Confluence page and tag finance for reclaim.

RECEIPT HANDLING (practical rules)
- Naming convention for photos: YYYYMMDD_vendor_amount_currency.jpg (e.g. 20251109_cafe-amsterdam_18.40_EUR.jpg)
- Always capture full paper receipt + card slip if present. If receipt small, place on white sheet and photo.
- For digital receipts (email/pdf): save as PDF and name with same convention.
- Daily 15-min: batch upload receipts to Drive folder -> attach to expense form before leaving hotel.

EXPENSE CATEGORIES & CODES (quick ref)
- Travel (air/train): TRV-REIMB
- Ground/cabs: TRV-GROUND
- Meals: TRV-MEAL (use per-diem override only with preapproval)
- Booth supplies/shipping: OPS-BOOTH
- Accommodation: TRV-HOTEL
- Misc (SIM, dongles): TRV-MISC

PER-DIEM / CASH ADVANCE (check local currency)
- Standard per-diem: $60 USD (domestic), 70 EUR (Europe) — confirm with finance for exceptions.
- Request cash advance at least 3 business days before travel.

VAT / TAX RECLAIM (EU quick steps)
- Get full vendor invoice with VAT number and company name exactly as on Redwood PO.
- Invoice must include VAT amount, tax ID, invoice date, and supplier VAT registration.
- If vendor only gives receipt (no VAT), ask for a pro-forma invoice. Many small vendors can issue one on request.
- Upload invoice to Confluence + tag finance (linked above). Finance handles EU reclaim; include original and translation if not in English.

VISA / ENTRY CHECKLIST (for short-notice trips)
- Check passport expiry > 6 months from return date.
- Quick country/visa lookup: government website + travel advisories (link to embassy).
- If ETA required, use e-visa portal and screenshot approval; attach to Drive and print a copy.
- Bring proof of accommodation + return ticket for border checks.

PACKING / BOOTH KIT (short checklist)
- Tech: 2x laptops (work + backup), multi-plug power strip (UK/EU/US adapters), 2x chargers, 2x portable battery packs
- AV: 1x HDMI cable, 1x USB-C -> HDMI dongle, mini HDMI adapter, spare USB thumb drive
- Booth: 200 promo cards, 1 roll gaffer tape, velcro strips, cable ties, black sharpie, small toolkit (screwdriver set), extension cord (10m), ethernet cable (10m)
- Misc: roll-up banner (packed), foam padding for crate, waterproof labels for shipments, 2x clear plastic binders for invoices/POs

COURIER & SHIPPING NOTES
- Preferred courier: ShipFast / express lane (email: ops@shipfast.co). Request DDP if possible to avoid on-site VAT surprises.
- Labeling: crate label must include "HANDLE: BOOTH KIT" + Redwood contact name + mobile.
- Customs docs: include commercial invoice + packing list. If components are sample/demo units, mark as "temporary admission" where allowed.
- On arrival: ask local handler for forklift window if crate > 20kg. Confirm arrival window 48h prior.

LOCAL VENDOR CONTACTS (quick rolodex)
- QuickSIM Mobile — local SIM + prepaid hotspot. Email: sales@quicksim.example, WhatsApp: +44 7700 900123 (confirm before purchase)
- CityCourier — same-day pickups. ops@citycourier.example, portal: citycourier.example/booking (account Redwood-inc)
- Onsite AV tech: Marco R. — marco@eventav.example (good for last-minute projector/adapter swaps)

COMMUNICATIONS & ESCALATION
- Primary on-site Slack: #events-ops (create thread with date and venue).
- Emergency escalation: call Samir (primary), then Elena; fill short incident note in Drive and flag finance if cost > $500.
- Local embassy number (if passport lost): lookup via travel gov site and save under phone contacts.

QUICK TEMPLATES (copy/paste)
- Courier pickup request (email):
  Subject: Pickup request - BOOTH KIT - [Event name] - [Dates]
  Body: Hi [courier],
  Please confirm pick up for crate (dimensions/weight) from [address] on [date]. AWB to be sent to ops@redwood.com. Contents: booth promo materials and demo hardware. Include commercial invoice and packing list. Require signature on delivery.

- Receipt upload note for team:
  "Hey team — quick reminder: photo receipts with filename YYYYMMDD_vendor_amount_currency.jpg -> upload to Drive/Shared/Events/[event]/receipts by EOD. If you used personal card, mark with TRV-REIMB and complete the expense form."

NOTES TO SELF / FRAGMENTS
- If we need VAT reclaim fast, request supplier to issue invoice under Redwood International LLC (check finance exact legal name).
- Consider prepaid SIM for last-minute travelers to avoid roaming bills.
- If short on promo cards, print a small run locally; check turnaround time (same-day printers exist but price spike).
- Keep extra hotel folio copy for finance reconciliation.

END (will tidy and move to Confluence once finalized).
